title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:11:0:00011:part:1/1
title_original: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 11 (Management and Use of Funds)
(1) The head of a research institution shall use the funds provided in accordance with Article 24(2) of the Act, for use only in the purpose necessary for the implementation of the project.
(2) The head of the Office for National Affairs may request the head of a research institution to submit a record of fund usage if he or she deems it necessary to verify the fund usage record of the research institution. (Amended on July 2, 2008, March 23, 2013)
(3) The head of a research institution who has been requested to submit a record of fund usage in accordance with paragraph (2) shall promptly submit it to the head of the Office for National Affairs. (Amended on July 2, 2008, March 23, 2013)
